about: Trail.build: stops = spots (marked or with photos) + clusters of located photos (≤ 150 m from the cluster's first photo and ≤ 10 min after its last), sorted by arrival then id; photos without GPS join the stop nearest in time if ≤ 10 min away, else the leg they were taken on. legs.count == stops.count + 1; songs go to the leg they started on. Distances are along the track (null without one).

cases.name: spot, two clusters, photos without GPS, songs
